scope: Shared CPU serial transaction driver for codec endpoint0, LCD panel endpoint1, backup endpoint9 and charge endpoint10. All four grounded descriptors use non-DMA operation. Other endpoint descriptors and DMA transfers are not exported by this slice.

owned_state.controller: 0x409c2644, three four-word arrays: phase, descriptor index, handle; transmit DMA handles0x409c2674 and receive DMA handles0x409c2684
owned_state.sequence: 0x409c2804, increment wrapping, exclude zero and live handles
owned_state.semaphores: Actual table0x7a22b4: channel0=0x15(decimal21),channel1=0x16(decimal22),channel2=0x17(decimal23). This family exports channel0/1; LensTransport separately owns channel2.

physical_dependencies: Serial MMIO bank0xfff84000+channel*64, offsets0..28; controller busy clears physically before stop/close returns
Serial hardware status bits8,9,12; receive/transmit threshold registers low5 bits; receive FIFO low16 bits
GPIO output0xfff89000+port*64 with upper-half write-enable mask; active-low chip select
Physical elapsed-time timer used by shared delay implementation
status_abi: Seven u32 words; offsets0,4,8 flags8,9,12; offsets12,16 threshold low5; offsets20,24 interrupt-enable bits18,26. No completion substitution or timeout.

adopted_dma_cleanup.source: Pinned app/drivers/isp/fff020_channel_initialization.c, hw_fff020_stop_channel_transfer and hw_fff020_close_channel; raw665424..66553c and665880..665ac4 confirm layout and control/status masks.
adopted_dma_cleanup.serial_stop: After phase1 publication, serial disable, busy wait and chip-select release, stop each nonzero transmit/receive DMA handle without clearing those serial slots. Ignore cleanup return.
adopted_dma_cleanup.serial_close: After serial disable and busy wait, invalidate serial endpoint and phase, close each nonzero transmit/receive DMA handle and clear its serial slot, invalidate serial handle, then signal serial semaphore. Ignore DMA close return.
adopted_dma_cleanup.dma_stop: Resolve nonzero handle in918bd8[8]; reject missing handle-20 or nonactive state-11. Set pause bit8; poll busy bit0 until clear or paused bit3; on paused set abort bit1 and poll pending bit2 using the current status sample. Set clear bit3, release interrupt token, then publish state1.
adopted_dma_cleanup.dma_close: Resolve handle; release interrupt token; invalidate kind918bb8[channel], state918b98[channel], and handle918bd8[channel]; signal semaphore channel+11. Signal failure returns stock-255; otherwise preserve interrupt release status.
adopted_dma_cleanup.interrupt_release: Reuse xm1_power_timer_release_handle, actual64eb20, and clear918bf8[channel] even when release fails.

phase_admission: Handle lookup does not reject phase0 or unrecognized adopted phase words. Configure accepts only phase1 and returns-12 otherwise. Stop rejects only phase1 with-11. Write/read/status reject phase0 with-10 before accessing MMIO or changing output. Raw64c540..64c550,64d24c..64d25c,64d2f8..64d308 establish the operation-specific guards.
write_status_note: Raw64c554 loads the entire uninitialized word at entrySP-20. Instructions64c558..64c598 force bits0,4,8,9,12,13. At64c5dc..64c5e4 the full residue OR0x3311 is ORed with hardware upper16 and written to bank+12. Core write requires explicit StatusResidue and preserves every bit. ARM shim loads entrySP-20 before its prologue and forwards that residue to xm1_power_serial_write_with_residue. No residue value is selected by the driver.
opened_handle_status_invariant: After successful open, reserve installs a nonzero unique handle and phase1. Every other reserve rejects a nonzero occupied channel handle. Configure changes phase1 to2; stop changes it to1; neither invalidates the handle. Write, read, status and delay do not modify serial handle/endpoint/phase arrays. Only close invalidates a handle. Thus a caller retaining its private handle until after its polling loop receives all seven status words on every poll. This proof requires that no external software closes another transaction's private handle or writes serial state RAM directly; physical serial MMIO does not write those CPU state arrays.

charge_source_bound_residue.first_write: Configure success establishes GPIOselect0 at original callerSP-20; configure error retains open's semaphore0x15.
charge_source_bound_residue.later_writes: Calls69e23c,69e244,69e24c,69e254 execute physical delay723ffc between bytes. Delay prologue723ffc..724004 setsr11=entrySP-4 andSP=entrySP-40. Instructions724010/724014 load timer period0xfff91004 and store it atentrySP-20; that local is not subsequently overwritten. The final delay's initial period sample is therefore the next serial write's exact source residue.
charge_source_bound_residue.required_shared_api: xm1_power_delay_us_with_residue(us:u32)->u32 must return the initial period sample already used by the owned delay algorithm. Charge caller must pass the final preceding delay's returned sample to xm1_power_serial_write_with_residue. An extra hardware period read does not establish identical source input.

lcd_source_bound_residue.caller_policy: 6d3eac bypasses write on open failure. After successful open,6d3eb8 calls configure and6d3ec8 calls write without testing configure result.
lcd_source_bound_residue.explicit_residue: LCD must pass ABI third argument0 on configure success and0x16 on configure error. These produce different status writes:0x3311 versus0x3317 before preserved hardware upper16. No normalization to0 is justified on error.

native_equivalence_dependencies: Physical effects of register+12 bits outside0,4,8,9,12,13 are not established. No claim that other residue bits are inert.

Recompiled caller frames can change entrySP-20 contents. Native stock-equivalence requires a source-bound caller-residue witness or an explicit residue supplied through xm1_power_serial_write_with_residue; capturing replacement entry stack alone does not establish original caller residue equivalence.
Cleanup reuses the shared xm1_power_timer_release_handle registry executor. Both domain-specific RTOS root artifacts must be bound at their actual carrier addresses.
